invariants.evidence: A valid envelope is not proof of provenance by itself. Only a trusted provider-normalization/application boundary may construct these inputs. No input DTO is exposed as a public request. FRESH with absent/expired/future verification timestamps yields UNKNOWN.
invariants.transfer: Durations are nonnegative integer seconds. Self-transfer deplane and configured buffer are mandatory; other applicability must be evidenced. Protected MCT-covered terms are excluded; coverage unknown leaves the sum UNKNOWN. Negative connection window is INFEASIBLE. If protection is unknown, a self-transfer subtotal cannot prove infeasibility. known_required_seconds is a diagnostic subtotal, not a safe connection claim. Proven cutoff miss independently rejects.
invariants.inventory: Event active_recommendation requires fresh SCHEDULED plus AVAILABLE. Ticket CTA additionally requires valid fixed start/timezone and fresh allowlisted HTTPS ticket link. Food PRICE_LEVEL never converts to Money. Host list is supplied only from approved provider authority configuration; no default host is trusted.
invariants.opportunity: Only the existing canonical verified_price from an owner-scoped selection is compared. No historical dataset or predicted price. MATCH does not book or emit a notification.
